marks.label: Desktop shortcut
marks.desc: Puts a launcher shortcut on the desktop (recommended).

marks.label: Open at startup
marks.desc: Opens the launcher automatically when the computer starts. Recommended for a dedicated gate computer.

marks.label: Add to PATH
marks.desc: For IT staff who run the launcher from a command prompt. Usually not needed.

marks.label: Back / Next / Cancel
marks.desc: Next continues, Back returns to the previous page, and Cancel quits Setup without installing anything.
